settings.title: The conference for people who actually ship .

settings.editor: Three days of hard-won lessons from the builders behind products you use every day. No fluff, no keynotes, no sales pitches.

ShipCon is a three-day, single-track conference with no sponsored talks and no product demos on stage. Every speaker is someone who has shipped real products at scale and is willing to share what actually worked — and what didn't.
Founders, engineers, and designers behind products that millions use.
A preview of the opening day. Full schedule revealed next month.
09:00Registration & breakfastCoffee, pastries, and a lot of name tags. Meet your fellow attendees before the real work begins.
10:00Opening keynote: What we broke this yearAn honest retrospective from four founders about the mistakes that almost killed their companies — and how they recovered.
11:30The economics of shippingHow small teams decide what to build, what to cut, and when to stop polishing.
13:00Lunch & hallway trackLong lunch. No schedule. Meet the people you came to meet.
14:30Workshop rotationsFour parallel 90-minute workshops on scaling, design systems, observability, and hiring.
We release tickets in three batches. Join the list to hear about each one first.
An independent conference for product builders. Run by volunteers, funded by tickets and a handful of great sponsors.
